leaf_classes.path_semantics: leaf paths are key tuples, relative to one runs[i]; per_query rows are paired by their 'query' field
leaf_classes.skipped: binary_classification or ordinal_classification in P (threshold metrics not computed)
leaf_classes.identifier: fraction, seed exactly; checkpoint by its last two path components (the published JSON holds an absolute Mac path)
leaf_classes.exact: P[-1] in {selected_weight, n_queries} or queries_with_both_classes in P or confusion_matrix in P or (P[-1] == n and tier_stats in P); selected_weight has the near-tie exception (gap < 1e-4)
leaf_classes.rank: any of {validation_selection_curve, ranking, ranking_macro, per_query, global_auc, macro_query_auc} in P, or P[-1] in {kendall_tau_b, spearman_rho}

float_tie.rule: a failing rank_per_query leaf passes iff its anchor has >= 1 float-tied group (raw text gap < gap with identical phi in the fusion arm, or ranked-score gap < arm_gap) and some ordering of the tied records reproduces the published value within the rank_per_query tolerance; logged as an event

2c.note: a typed-check failure only removes T (no stop)
